remarks: Nestled on 2.14 beautiful acres in Elma, this well-maintained split-level home offers the perfect blend of comfortable living, modern updates, and space to enjoy the outdoors, all within the highly sought-after Iroquois School District! Featuring 3 bedrooms and 1.5 baths, this home offers a welcoming open living and dining area, along with a kitchen boasting granite countertops and stainless steel appliances.  The fully updated full bath is a true standout, showcasing beautiful tile work, a double-sink vanity, and radiant heated floors. The lower level provides additional living space with a cozy family room and convenient half bath. An attached 2.5-car garage features epoxy floors, while the adjoining sun porch offers the perfect spot for a workshop, additional storage or transform it into a spot to sit back and relax.  Car enthusiasts, hobbyists, and outdoor lovers will appreciate the detached two-bay garage/outbuilding, offering endless possibilities for hobbies, storage, or workspace. Outside, enjoy the expansive property, concrete patio with Pergola, chain-link fenced area, and a driveway with a convenient turnaround.  Numerous updates add peace of mind, including a new boiler, windows, central air, generator hookup, a roof less than four years old, and more!  If you're looking for room to spread out, space for your hobbies, and a property that embraces the best of country living while remaining in a demand location, this Elma gem is a must-see!  SqFt based on plans attached.
